EN: Let's start crafting! {DOUBLE TAP} on the {ULTRACITE WEAPON FACTORY} to take a closer look.
ZH: 开始打造吧！{双击}{辐射极琉矿武器工坊}近距离查看。

EN: Let's start crafting! {DOUBLE CLICK} on the {ULTRACITE WEAPON FACTORY} to take a closer look.
ZH: 开始打造吧！{双击}{辐射极琉矿武器工坊}近距离查看。

EN: Let's start crafting! {HOLD} [RT] on the {ULTRACITE WEAPON FACTORY} to take a closer look.
ZH: 开始打造吧！在{辐射极琉矿武器工坊}上{长按}近距离查看。

EN: Time to fight back against those {SCORCHED}! Now that we have some {ULTRACITE}, let's use it to craft some powerful new {WEAPONS}.
ZH: 是时候反击那些{辐尸人}了！既然我们已经有了{辐射极琉矿}，就用它来打造几件强力的新{武器}吧。

EN: Cannot be destroyed. Build an Ultracite Mine here.
ZH: 无法摧毁。在此建造辐射极琉矿矿场。

EN: Limit Reached.
ZH: 达到上限。

EN: You have already given Pets to {0} Dwellers, the maximum number of Pets allowed by Vault-Tec.
ZH: 您已经给{0}位居民分配了宠物，达到了避难所科技允许的最大值。

EN: You have 200 Dwellers, the maximum number of Dwellers allowed by Vault-Tec.
ZH: 您已拥有200位居民，已达到避难所科技允许的最大人口数。

EN: Instantly return to the Vault for {0} Nuka-Cola Quantum?
ZH: 立即用{0}瓶量子核子可乐返回避难所吗？

EN: Wasteland slots are full
ZH: 废土探索的居民已达到上限。

EN: That Dweller is not in the Vault
ZH: 此居民不在避难所内。

EN: Please sign in to the Windows Store with the {0} Xbox LIVE account.
ZH: 请用{0}Xbox LIVE账号登录进入Windows Store。

EN: A new version is available. The game will be closed to download and apply the update.
ZH: 一个新的版本可用。游戏将关闭来下载安装更新。

EN: Version {0} is now available. The game will be closed to download and apply the update.
ZH: {0}版本现在可用。游戏将关闭来下载安装更新。

EN: You must be online to play. Please connect to Xbox LIVE.
ZH: 必须要联网才能玩，请连接至Xbox LIVE。

EN: Something went wrong. Please try again or restart the game.
ZH: 出错。请重试，或重启游戏。

EN: This action requires an internet connection. Please connect to the internet and try again
ZH: 这项动作需要网络连接。请连接至网络重试。

EN: Mole rat
ZH: 鼹鼠

EN: Mole rats
ZH: 鼹鼠

EN: Backup to free slot
ZH: 备份到空档

EN: Oh my. I certainly hope all this firepower is just for show.
ZH: 哦，天哪。我真希望这些火力只是摆设。

EN: Oh my. I certainly hope all this firepower is just for show.
ZH: 哦，天哪。我真希望这些火力只是摆设。

EN: I never did understand the concept of legs, or moving them. For goodness sake, humans... HOVER.
ZH: 我一直不明白腿有什么用，或者说为什么要动它们。人类啊，你们就不能漂浮起来吗？

EN: I never did understand the concept of legs, or moving them. For goodness sake, humans... HOVER.
ZH: 我一直不明白腿有什么用，或者说为什么要动它们。人类啊，你们就不能漂浮起来吗？

EN: Anyone fancy a tipple?
ZH: 有谁想来一杯吗？

EN: You humans relax. No, no. It's fine. I'll just selflessly tend to your every need...
ZH: 你们人类歇着吧。不不，不用管我。我就默默无私地伺候各位的一切需求……

EN: BlamCo? Cram? InstaMash? And humans actually enjoy this garbage?
ZH: 白兰哥？饱饱牌肉罐头？快餐薯泥？人类竟然真吃这些垃圾？

EN: Thank Heavens General Atomics International spared me from the threat of nausea. And obesity.
ZH: 感谢通用原子国际让我免受恶心和肥胖的威胁。

EN: Ahhh, education. The only thing they can never take truly away from you.
ZH: 啊，教育。这是他们唯一永远无法真正从你身上夺走的东西。

EN: Ahhh, education. The only thing they can never take truly away from you.
ZH: 啊，教育。这是他们唯一永远无法真正从你身上夺走的东西。

EN: Ah, cardio. Fascinating concept.
ZH: 啊，有氧运动。真是个有趣的概念。

EN: Ah, cardio. Fascinating concept.
ZH: 啊，有氧运动。真是个有趣的概念。

EN: Hmph. Just let these humans try and beat my high score in Red Menace...
ZH: 哼，就让这些人类来挑战我在《红色威胁》中的高分吧……

EN: Hmph. Just let these humans try and beat my high score in Red Menace...
ZH: 哼，就让这些人类来挑战我在《红色威胁》中的高分吧……

EN: If the humans are happy, I'm happy. I swear.
ZH: 人类开心，我就开心。我发誓。

EN: So many humans, so little time.
ZH: 人类如此之多，我的时间却如此之少。

EN: Entombed in cold, unyielding steel. It's robot Heaven.
ZH: 长眠于冰冷坚硬的钢铁之中——这就是机器人的天堂。

EN: My kingdom for an oil bath...
ZH: 我渴望一场机油浴……

EN: If I've told them once, I've told them a thousand times. NO. PEDICURES.
ZH: 这话我跟他们说过不下一千遍了：不。做。修。脚。

EN: Do this, do that. But do I get a “thank you”? Nooooo...
ZH: 做这个，做那个。可我听过一句“谢谢”吗？没——有……

EN: Yes, Overseer, I know you're watching. I'm working as fast as I bloody can...
ZH: 是的，监督者，我知道你在看着。我已经在拼了命地赶工了……

EN: I am a Mister Handy model robot. The pride of General Atomics International!
ZH: 我是巧手先生型机器人，通用原子国际的骄傲！

EN: Not a day goes by that I don't revel in the servitude of humankind.
ZH: 每天我都沉浸在为人类服务的喜悦中。

EN: Live to serve, serve to live...
ZH: 活着是为了服务，服务是为了活着……

EN: Coming, coming! I'll be with you in two ticks!
ZH: 来啦，来啦！我马上就来！

EN: They don't call me Mister Handy for nothing.
ZH: “巧手先生”这名字可不是白叫的。

EN: Hello, humans. Mister Handy here, ready to serve your every whim!
ZH: 你好，人类。巧手先生在此，随时伺候各位的每个突发奇想！

EN: What do you need? Dusting? Mopping? General tidying?
ZH: 需要什么？除尘？拖地？还是一般的整理？

EN: Now now, I don't do windows. Oh wait! You don't have any! Ha ha ha. Sorry, robot humor...
ZH: 先说好，我不擦窗户。哦，等等！你们根本没有窗户！哈哈哈。抱歉，这是机器人的幽默……

EN: Feeling lazy? You called the right robot! You want it, I'll fetch it.
ZH: 懒得动？那你可找对机器人了！你想要什么，我去拿。

EN: I'll do whatever I can to support you humans' fat, lazy lifestyle.
ZH: 我会尽我所能支持你们人类肥胖懒惰的生活方式。

EN: Sometimes these humans feel like characters in a video game. Incapable of doing anything on their own...
ZH: 有时候，这些人类感觉就像视频游戏里的角色，无法独立完成任何事情……

EN: I have to admit. For a giant metal hole in the ground, this Vault is exceedingly cozy.
ZH: 对于地底下这么个巨大的金属坑来说，这个避难所非常舒适。

EN: Oh look, a layer of dust. Because who doesn't love cleaning discarded human hair and skin.
ZH: 哦，快看，一层灰。毕竟，谁会不喜欢清理人类掉的毛发和皮屑呢。

EN: Joke time! What do you get when you put root beer in a square glass? Give up? Beer! Oh I slay me...
ZH: 讲笑话时间！把根汁啤酒“开平方”，会得到什么？——啤酒！哦，我能把自己笑死……

EN: You hear about the light that went bad? They put it in prism. Get it? Prism?
ZH: 听说有个灯泡学坏了？他们把它关进了“棱镜”（prism，谐音监狱 prison）。懂吗？棱镜？

EN: They say there are 10 different kinds of people in the world. Those who understand binary... and those who don't.
ZH: 他们说世界上有10种人。懂二进制的和不懂二进制的。

EN: Before the blasted war, I probably would have had a nice suburban family to take care of...
ZH: 在那场该死的战争之前，我可能会照顾一个生活小康的郊区家庭……

EN: What's on the agenda for today? Mopping, cooking, dusting, babysitting? Bring it on, humans!
ZH: 今天的日程是什么？拖地、做饭、除尘、带孩子？放马过来吧，人类！

EN: Have hover unit, will travel. Just let me know what you need, people.
ZH: 自带悬浮单元，说走就走。各位有什么需要，尽管吩咐。

EN: Personally, I think all this talk of an “Overseer” is so much rubbish. I've certainly never seen them.
ZH: 个人认为，关于“监督者”的所有说法都是胡说八道。我从来没有见过他们。

EN: I do hope there's no diaper changing today. The little humans are always so... wiggly.
ZH: 真希望今天不用换尿布。那些小家伙总是……扭来扭去。

EN: Cheerio, Vault Dwellers!
ZH: 再见，避难所居民！

EN: Is that... oh, it is. Blood on the floor. Wonderful.
ZH: 这是什么……哦，还真是。地板上有血。太“棒”了。

EN: There's not enough Abraxo on the planet to scrub this place clean.
ZH: 把全世界的艾巴索清洁剂都拿来，也刷不干净这地方。

EN: Ugh. This place leaks like a sieve. And me without my brolly.
ZH: 呃，这地方漏得跟筛子似的。偏偏我又没带伞。

EN: I wonder if we could convert one of these rooms into a proper study. Fireplace, bookshelves... gin.
ZH: 我想知道我们能不能把其中一个房间改造成一个正经的书房。壁炉、书架……还有杜松子酒。

EN: These humans can be so hard to understand. Everyone has SUCH an accent.
ZH: 这些人类真是太难理解了。每个人都有那么重的口音。

EN: Hard work is happy work? Like you humans would know.
ZH: 努力工作令人快乐？你们人类真的懂吗？

EN: Tsk tsk tsk. I'd need a firehose attachment to give this place a proper washing.
ZH: 啧啧啧。我得加装一个高压水带配件，才洗得干净这地方。

EN: Dinner tonight - Beef Wellington and a bottle of Bordeaux! Just kidding. It's Cram again.
ZH: 今晚的晚餐——惠灵顿牛排配一瓶波尔多！开个玩笑。又是饱饱牌肉罐头。

EN: Olfactory sensors picking up... vomit and chocolate. There must be children about.
ZH: 嗅觉传感器检测到……呕吐物和巧克力。附近一定有个小孩子。

EN: I do hope the humans are happy today. Grumpy Vault Dwellers are so difficult to care for.
ZH: 希望这些人类今天开心。脾气暴躁的避难所居民可麻烦了。

EN: This place could do with a few houseplants. Tulips, cacti... perhaps a life-sized Venus flytrap.
ZH: 这个地方需要一些室内植物。郁金香、仙人掌……也许还有一个真人大小的捕蝇草。

EN: As soon as I get one room under control, they build another! It's madness!
ZH: 我刚收拾完一个房间，他们就又建了个新的！真是疯了！

EN: And so the humans go about their work, like so many ants in a hill.
ZH: 人类就像一群蚂蚁一样忙碌着。

EN: I see a long, luxurious oil bath in my future...
ZH: 我梦想着未来的豪华机油浴……

EN: So many humans seek solace in love. Nobody cares about my soulmate.
ZH: 这么多人类都在爱情里寻找慰藉，却没人在意我的灵魂伴侣。

EN: The lighting in here is horrible. If I had eyes, they'd be ruined. Though I'd probably look dashing in horn rims...
ZH: 这里的灯光太差了。如果我有眼睛，它们早就废了。不过戴上眼镜，我可能会很帅……

EN: I wonder if the kitchen needs help. I make a mean flambe'.
ZH: 厨房需要帮忙吗？我做火焰料理很拿手。
